created_prompt: I'm a creator who makes cooking videos on a regular basis to my 1.2 million followers. They love watching my shorts and videos about quick and healthy recipes and making cooking easier. I want to grow my following online and eventually publish my own cookbook, but I'm not sure whether I should publish it on my own or look for a publisher to help me. I work my regular day job 4 days a week and I have little free time and only a small budget to work with. Create a concrete step-by-step plan to achieve these goals within 3 years and also provide the advantages and disadvantages between publishing my cookbook by myself or with a traditional publisher.
